{{Quote|While you were gone, a Dynath miner was damaged by a Black Sun destroyer near the Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt.|[[Laetin A'shera]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" />}}
[[File:BrightJewelAsteroidDebris.jpg|230px|thumb|A spacecraft debris among the asteroids]]
An '''Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt''' was situated near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]. A debris of a vessel was known to be strewn among the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. The asteroid belt was mined by the [[Dynath Miners]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Battle of Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Battle of Tansarii Point Station]], [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] targeted [[Unidentified transport class|Dynathian transports]] in the Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt. [[Car'das/Legends|Car'das]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] dispatched by [[Laetin A'shera]] finally repelled Black Sun forces and escorted Dynathian ships safely back to the [[H-5 70 Mining Facility]].<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Masul'ivis Asteroid Belt appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EtDMBTtS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
